ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Rundll32 Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious execution of rundll32, with specific calls to some DLLs with known LOLBIN functionalities

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*javascript\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.RegisterXLL.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*url\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenURL.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*url\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenURLA.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*url\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*FileProtocolHandler.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*zipfldr\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*RouteTheCall.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Control\\_RunDLL.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ShellExec\\_RunDLL.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*mshtml\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*PrintHTML.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*advpack\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*LaunchINFSection.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*advpack\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*RegisterOCX.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ieadvpack\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*LaunchINFSection.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ieadvpack\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*RegisterOCX.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ieframe\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenURL.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*shdocvw\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*OpenURL.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*syssetup\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*SetupInfObjectInstallAction.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*setupapi\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*InstallHinfSection.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*pcwutl\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*LaunchApplication.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*dfshim\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ShOpenVerbApplication.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*dfshim\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ShOpenVerbShortcut.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*scrobj\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*GenerateTypeLib.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*shimgvw\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ImageView\\_Fullscreen.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*comsvcs\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*MiniDump.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*shell32\\\.dll\\,Control\\_RunDLL\\ desk\\\.cpl\\,screensaver\\,\\@screensaver.*") OR (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\control\.exe" AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Shell32\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Control\\_RunDLL.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cpl.*"))) OR (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\control\.exe" AND process_command_line = RGX("^\\"C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\rundll32\\\.exe\\"\\ Shell32\\\.dll\\,Control\\_RunDLL\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") AND process_command_line = RGX("\\\.cpl\\"\\,$")))
